title: Ars Technica's Mac Mini review: The new M6 impresses but the price hike is rough
summary: Ars Technica reviews the new Apple Mac Mini powered by the M6 chip, finding the performance improvements impressive but heavily criticizing the $300 price increase that diminishes the value proposition of this otherwise solid hardware upgrade.
problem_solved: Evaluates whether the M6 Mac Mini upgrade is worth the premium pricing for consumers and pros.
why_valuable: Provides critical analysis of Apple's pricing strategy and helps readers make informed purchasing decisions about the Mac Mini upgrade.
